Public single-session interactive pipeline; excludes HTTP/WebRTC transport, output-video encoding, model load, and warmup. Full batch/service latency is not evaluated.
GX skips GPU arithmetic. Control shadows retain the original GPU reads and were checked during one native calibration; final native validation restores original controls.

The kernel database is reused unchanged, with exact launch inventories and full prediction coverage in both GX variants. Attention signatures still alias key lengths; per-call timing accuracy is not established by hit rate.
CPU calibration is on the GX host (EPYC 7702P), native confirmation on the A100 host (EPYC 9554); partial timing is a screen, not a guaranteed bound or exact latency prediction.

The PIL interface measures only the actual post-astype CPU conversion tail on local small fixtures. It excludes NumPy casting, GPU work, and D2H, and describes those observed states, not arbitrary input sizes or the whole model.
The merge path has higher per-image setup cost. The final patch keeps the original path below 4096 pixels per image, for non-planar storage, and for non-RGB channels.
Several full-model PCV annotations are underidentified because the standard session has one frame-block size; no complete affine model of the whole pipeline is claimed.
